rows.note: Use 高度 as the all-purpose noun for a location's height or a vertical distance.

example.english: The altitude of this mountain is three thousand metres.
example.traditional: 呢座山嘅高度有三千米。
example.jyutping: nei1 zo6 saan1 ge3 gou1 dou6 jau5 saam1 cin1 mai5

rows.note: Use 海拔 specifically when the height is measured above sea level.

example.english: This plateau has an altitude of three thousand metres above sea level.
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gou1 jyun4 hoi2 bat6 saam1 cin1 mai5
